subject.title: Add rate limiting and throttling for external API calls

question: Which outbound surfaces and enforcement semantics should the first supported rate-limit contract own?
rationale: A provider-only limiter is bounded, while unified model, tool, search, channel, budget, alerting, and CLI enforcement creates new configuration, persistence, scheduling, plugin API, and failure-semantics contracts.

options.title: Provider-first policy
options.body: Land an opt-in model-provider limiter with bounded queue-or-fail behavior, then track budgets and plugin-owned outbound surfaces separately.

options.title: Unified outbound policy
options.body: Design a generic contract covering model providers and tools, with an explicit plugin SDK capability for channel-owned behavior.

options.title: External policy layer
options.body: Retain reactive handling in core and rely on provider quotas, external observability, and plugin-specific pacing.

recommendation.title: Provider-first policy
recommendation.body: Land an opt-in model-provider limiter with bounded queue-or-fail behavior, then track budgets and plugin-owned outbound surfaces separately.
